Dual BA English + Classical Civ (UVM). ex-LexisNexis, Rosen Publishing. Frequent 'Smart Money' podcast contributor. Published 2 books on identity theft + YA nonfiction titles.

Joined Barron's from The Atlantic, where he launched The Masthead digital membership program. Prior: Eurasia Group, World Politics Review, Yale University. Recently moved to CNBC as Senior Economics Writer.

name: James Royal
role: Principal Writer, Investing & Wealth — Bankrate (Red Ventures); author
bio: Principal writer and editor at Bankrate (Red Ventures) covering investing, financial markets, wealth management, cryptocurrency and retirement topics (IRAs, 401(k) plans, Social Security). At Bankrate since 2019. Ph.D. Author of two books: 'The Zen of Thrift Conversions' and 'Options Trading 101' (both published by Simon & Schuster). Previously editor and analyst at The Motley Fool. Has been investing for 20+ years (since the dot-com era). Focuses on behavioral finance as a key driver of financial outcomes. Work cited by CNBC, The Washington Post, The New York Times, and the Associated Press.

name: Natalie Campisi
role: Senior Reporter — Personal Finance & Mortgages (Forbes Advisor)
bio: Senior Reporter at Forbes Advisor covering personal finance, mortgages, consumer finance, cybersecurity and consumer debt. Los Angeles-based creative writer and journalist. Previously Senior Mortgage Reporter at Bankrate Inc. (Jan 2017 – Jul 2020). Earlier positions at Associated Press and The Tampa Tribune. Her Forbes Advisor article 'From Inherent Racial Bias to Incorrect Data—The Problems with Current Credit Scoring Models' cited 16+ times including by CFPB and National Fair Housing Alliance.

bio: Co-founder and Partner at Reink Media Group (parent of StockBrokers.com, ForexBrokers.com, investor.com, StockTrader.com) and Head of Research at StockBrokers.com. 20+ years of trading experience, with thousands of trades placed. Created the original StockBrokers.com scoring rubric in 2011 and has headed every annual review since inception. Founded StockTrader.com (educational blog, now merged into StockBrokers.com). Author of 'The Interactive Guide to Technical Analysis'. Named to Crain's Detroit Business 'Top 20 in their 20s' (2009, age 22). Quoted in NYT, WSJ, Forbes, Chicago Tribune and Fa

Host of The Investopedia Express podcast. Began his business-news career at Bloomberg in 1997 as a senior television producer (Emmy-nominated in 2003 for 'Showdown on Secrecy'). Previously Director of Business News at CNN and Executive Producer of CNN Money, and a senior producer on The Situation Room with Wolf Blitzer. Left CNN in 2014 to form Frog Pond Productions. Before BuzzFeed was an Associate Editor at Bloomberg Businessweek. Four years based in China earlier in career.

role: Columnist & Editorial Board Member — Financial Times; Co-host, Unhedged (podcast)
bio: Columnist and member of the Financial Times editorial board, writing the Long View column on market trends. Previously FT Markets Editor. Co-host of the Unhedged podcast (Financial Times & Pushkin Industries) with Robert Armstrong — a markets-focused twice-weekly show. London-based. Ex-WSJ / Dow Jones. No longer posts on X; active on Bluesky as @katie0martin.

name: Kshitij Anand
role: Editor — ETMarkets (The Economic Times); host of Mind Over Money, Smart Talk, Trade Talk, PMS Talk, AIF Talk

Host of flagship ETMarkets video series: Mind Over Money, Smart Talk, Trade Talk, PMS Talk, and AIF Talk. Host of ETMarkets Morning Podcast (IMDb credited since 2017). Began financial journalism career in 2008. CFA charterholder (ICFAI) + MS Finance. HIGH RELEVANCE for India broker market.

name: Margaret Yang Yan, CFA
role: Strategist — DailyFX / IG
bio: Strategist at DailyFX (IG Group's partner site for FX news and analysis). 9+ years of dealing and trading experience in equities, fund management and CFDs. Deep understanding of multiple asset classes including equities, bonds, treasuries, FX, cryptocurrencies and commodities. Previously with CMC Markets Singapore and PhillipCapital. Frequent media contributor: Bloomberg, Reuters, BBC, Channel News Asia, Financial Times, Straits Times, Business Times, WSJ. Conducts trading lectures and speaks at investment conferences across APAC.

name: Ben Levisohn
role: Editor in Chief (was Senior Managing Editor)
bio: Editor in Chief of Barron's (appointed 2025). 15-year veteran of Dow Jones. Most recently served as Senior Managing Editor and was the driving force behind Barron's Investor Circle premium experience. Began career as Wall Street equities trader, spending seven years at Worldco and Lynx Capital Partners. Joined Dow Jones in 2010 as a reporter for the Weekend Investor section of The Wall Street Journal; joined Barron's in 2012 as an emerging markets writer before transitioning to U.S. markets. Penned Barron's popular Streetwise and Trader columns for a decade. Based in New York.

name: Claer Barrett
role: Consumer Editor / Associate Editor — Financial Times (Money Clinic podcast host)
bio: Associate Editor and Consumer Editor at Financial Times. Presents weekly Money Clinic podcast and writes the Serious Money column in FT Weekend. 15+ years as consumer/personal finance journalist. Author of 'What They Don't Teach You About Money' (2023). ITV Lorraine contributor, LBC & BBC Radio personality. Trustee at FLIC (Financial Literacy & Inclusion Campaign).

Founder of Perry Market Analysis, providing consultancy, research, webinars and written analysis on forex, commodities, CFDs and macro to brokers and financial websites. Former lead analyst at Hantec Markets (2013-2021) and INFINOX (2021-2023). Regular fixture on CNBC and Bloomberg TV. Expertise spans technical and fundamental analysis with focus on major forex pairs, commodities, CFDs and Bitcoin.

Nearly 10 years at Marijuana Business Daily (writer/editor). Previously a 10-year correspondent for Religion News Service and a diplomat for the Foreign Ministry of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Columbia Journalism School graduate, 1997. Work published in New York Times, Washington Post, Newsweek, Forbes. Third place, American Academy of Religion Best Newswriting Contest (2006).

role: CFP — Investopedia Advisor Council; CFP Board Ambassador (NY)
bio: President and founder of Bone Fide Wealth, LLC. Became one of the youngest CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER™ professionals in the country early in his career. Member of the Investopedia Advisor Council (founding group of 25 paid contributors) and CNBC Advisor Council. CFP Board Ambassador for New York. Media source on Millennial finance — appearances on CNBC's On The Money, Nightly Business Report, ABC's World News Tonight, Good Morning America, Cheddar; quoted in New York Times and Wall Street Journal.

name: Jesse Hamilton
role: Deputy Managing Editor, Global Policy & Regulation — CoinDesk
bio: Deputy Managing Editor on CoinDesk's Global Policy and Regulation team, based in Washington, D.C. Joined CoinDesk in 2022 after more than a decade at Bloomberg News and Businessweek covering Wall Street regulation — including early federal deliberations on crypto policy. Prior career as a war correspondent in Iraq and as a police reporter, earning multiple national honours. Graduate of Western Washington University (journalism and history). Has a Wikipedia entry (Jesse A. Hamilton).

bio: Chief Editor of CompareForexBrokers.com and Senior Financial Analyst at Google (Alphabet), leading advertising incentive programs for key partners. Licensed CPA. Founder and CEO of Young and the Invested, a personal finance platform for young investors and parents. Previously Regulatory Strategy Analyst at Entergy Corporation in New Orleans (6 yrs). Cited as authoritative source in CNBC, Time, NBC News, APM's Marketplace, HuffPost, Business Insider, NerdWallet, Investopedia, MarketWatch, Kiplinger, The Balance, Fast Company.

name: Michael Hewson
role: Senior Financial Strategist — iFOREX / Contributor — Good Money Guide (ex-Chief Market Analyst CMC Markets, 15+ yrs)
bio: Market analyst with 30+ years in financial markets, focused on both technical and fundamental analysis. Spent 16+ years at CMC Markets (10+ as Chief Market Analyst, based in London) before stepping down in 2024. Background in FX trading; before CMC spent 12+ years in market data, education and support. Now Senior Financial Strategist at iFOREX and podcast contributor / author at Good Money Guide. Regular face on Bloomberg, CNBC, BBC, CNN, Fox Business. City AM Analyst of the Year nominations (2019, 2021).

name: Will Daniel
role: Senior Reporter — Fortune (former)
bio: Senior reporter covering markets and the economy. At Fortune magazine since March 2022, covering markets and the economy; per Talking Biz News, has since departed Fortune. Previously at Markets Insider, Markitors and Seeking Alpha. Holds an MS in Business Journalism from Arizona State University's Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication. Bylines at Yahoo Entertainment, Business Insider and Markets Insider.

Joined IG Asia in Singapore and began contributing to DailyFX in 2022. Master's in Development Economics (University of London, UK) and Master's in Financial Services Management (University of Mumbai, India). Chartered Market Technician (CMT) and Certified Financial Technician (CFTe).

name: Jeff Ostrowski

bio: 20+ years covering real estate, business, economy and politics. Writer and Housing Market Analyst at Bankrate. Previously at the Palm Beach Post and South Florida Business Journal. Board member of the National Association of Real Estate Editors (2019-2025); two NAREE gold awards; Best in Business award from the Society for Advancing Business Editing and Writing. Authored 'How to Buy a Home in a Miserable Market'. Quoted in NYT, CNN, Cheddar, NTD.

Practiced law until 1997, then was recruited to an international securities firm. Author of the best-selling book 'Juggling Dynamite: An insider's wisdom on money management, markets and wealth that lasts' and maintains a daily financial blog at jugglingdynamite.com. Active Seeking Alpha contributor since 2014 (845+ analyses). Member of CFA Institute, Toronto Society of Financial Analysts, and Law Society of Upper Canada.

role: Personal Finance Writer — Bloomberg Wealth team

Previously a personal finance writer and editor on Bloomberg's dedicated digital team, spearheading multi-platform retirement and investing projects. Joined Bloomberg in 2009 via the BusinessWeek acquisition, where she headed the magazine's personal finance section from 2005. Prior to that, editor and writer at Money magazine.

name: Sharon Epperson
role: Senior Personal Finance Correspondent — CNBC

Adjunct professor at Columbia University's School of International and Public Affairs. Began with CNBC in 1996. Expertise: saving and investing for retirement, paying for college, managing mortgage/student loan/credit card debt, building financial legacy through estate planning.

Experience includes building index products for investment banks, risk management, analytics, and macroeconomic analysis. Previously wrote for Ledger, Decrypt, OKEx, BeInCrypto, Republic Crypto, and Cryptonews.

name: Scott Murdoch
role: Lead Writer, Asia Finance & Markets — Reuters
bio: Lead Writer for Asia Finance & Markets at Reuters (formerly Asia Capital Markets Correspondent). Journalist for more than two decades with Thomson Reuters and News Corp in Australia, specialising in financial journalism. Covers equity and debt capital markets across Asia and Australian M&A. Previously Data Room Co-Editor at The Australian (2017-2019) and China Correspondent in Beijing. Co-founder of @sandochracing. Based in Sydney.

bio: Writer for CNN covering investments and real estate, focusing on traditional, alternative, real estate and cryptocurrency markets. Currently Housing & Personal Finance reporter at CNN Business. Prior: launched financial coverage at Mic; broke housing news during the financial crisis as real estate reporter for USA Today. Nearly a decade at The New York Times covering real estate, youth culture, travel; reported from ground zero on September 11, 2001. Fellow at Columbia Journalism Review.
